				<lb n="8a6"/> mchog tu gyur pa la dad pa dang gus pa lhur len pa'i | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">dge ba'i bshes gnyen mi nyag blo ldan dpal</rs> zhes bya ba || <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa</rs> la bstod pa gsol 'debs dang dang bcas pa 1 gyis zhes bskul ba'i rjes su <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5066"><expan>slob dpon</expan> dpal ldan <expan>ye shes</expan></rs> kyis kyang bskul ba'i ngor ||</note> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa</rs> de nyid kyi bka' 'bangs su gyur pa | ma Ni ba <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4066">thogs med</rs> kyis | <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5692">dngul chu'i chos rdzong</rs> du
